name: TracktCRM – Form Leads to CRM
author: tracktcrm

sections.description:
Every form submission on your website becomes a lead in TracktCRM — with name, email, phone, message, every extra field, the page it came from and the UTM campaign.

  • One-click connect: click “Connect to TracktCRM”, log in, click Allow. No API key copy-paste.
  • Works with Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms, Forminator and Elementor Pro Forms.
  • Fields are mapped automatically. Change the mapping per form if you need to.
  • Turn each form on or off.
  • Captures utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, utm_content, gclid, fbclid and the referring site.
  • Never loses a lead: leads are stored on your site first and retried automatically if TracktCRM can’t be reached or your subscription is paused.
  • Duplicate-safe: retries never create a second lead, and repeat enquiries from the same phone or email are added to the existing lead.

A TracktCRM paid plan is required to receive leads. Start at https://tracktcrm.com

External services

This plugin connects to the TracktCRM service to send form submissions into your CRM account. No data is sent until a site administrator connects the plugin.

  • Service: TracktCRM (https://tracktcrm.com)
  • API endpoint: https://api.tracktcrm.com
  • Dashboard / OAuth connect: https://dashboard.tracktcrm.com
  • Data sent after connect: submitted form fields, form name, page URL and title, referrer, and UTM / click-id parameters
  • Terms of Service: https://tracktcrm.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://tracktcrm.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Go to TracktCRM in the WordPress menu.
  3. Click “Connect to TracktCRM”, log in and click Allow.
  4. Submit one of your forms — the lead appears in TracktCRM.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

No. “Connect to TracktCRM” does it for you. An API key option is available under “Connect with an API key instead” for sites where the browser flow isn’t possible.

What happens if my subscription expires?

New leads are kept on your site and sent automatically once your plan is active again (for up to 30 days).

Which pipeline and owner do leads go to?

The ones you choose on the Allow screen, or your account default and assignment rules.
